youtube.title: Why Mosquitoes Bite Some People More 🦟 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Mosquitoes really do prefer some people. And scientists found out why.

First they track the carbon dioxide you breathe out, from metres away. Up close, they follow your body heat and your skin's smell. In one study, the most attractive person drew a hundred times more mosquitoes than the least. The magnets had more of certain acids on their skin. And they stayed magnets for years. And only the females bite. They need your blood to make eggs.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
